description: GRINDLINE: THPS2-style arcade skating in Godot 4 — one dusk industrial plaza, 2-minute scored runs, ollies/grinds/manuals, S-K-A-T-E objectives, 4-skater roster, ship-quality.
regressionVerify: jq -r '.userStories[] | select(.passes==true) | .verify' scripts/ralph/prd.json | while IFS= read -r cmd; do echo "REGRESSION: $cmd"; bash -c "$cmd" || exit 1; done

userStories.title: Playable vertical slice: control-to-score-to-restart loop
userStories.description: Capstone of phase 1 (all US-1xx mini-stories must carry passes:true first). From boot: title/menu leads into a run in a minimal park cell where the skater pushes (W), steers, ollies (Space) over an obstacle, bails or lands, scores at least one combo, sees timer expiry end the run, and restarts cleanly. Sim bridge drives reset(3)/start(run)/input sequences and asserts the full state chain mechanically.
acceptanceCriteria: godot --headless --path . --import parses with zero errors
sim bridge input sequence push-steer-ollie yields airborne state within 500 ms sim time
landing a completed ollie adds score and increments combo counter exactly once
timer expiry transitions run_state to results without orphan nodes
restart reseeds identical park layout and zeroed score within 1 s
tests_staged/test_q01_vertical_slice.sh exits 0 printing SIM RESULT pass

userStories.title: Look lock: one final-quality slice (lighting, materials, HUD, framing)
userStories.description: Capstone of phase 2 (all US-2xx mini-stories pass first). One canonical frame pair reaches ship bar: dusk HDRI sky, sunset key light, PBR concrete/asphalt ground, colormap kit props, Bebas Neue HUD chips with hard shadows; captured via sim bridge screenshots at title and primary-action states and compared against reference mechanisms (palette separation, silhouette readability) recorded in QUALITY-LEDGER.md.
acceptanceCriteria: shots/title.png and shots/primary-action.png exist, are valid PNGs at 1280x720
sim-reported palette check finds safety-yellow accent and steel-gray metal pixel clusters in traversal frame
skater silhouette contrast against sky exceeds 35 percent mean luminance delta in airborne frame
HUD uses font-bebas glyphs only; no engine default font pixels in chip regions
QUALITY-LEDGER.md gains a look-lock finding row with measured values

userStories.title: Asset integration: every shipping asset loads through the measured adapter
userStories.description: Capstone of phase 3 (all US-3xx mini-stories pass first). Park builder instantiates the full LEDGEWORKS layout from data: all 8 authored street pieces, Kenney kit pieces, factory props, five PBR surface sets, HDRI, characters with clip map, board, audio banks. Each asset flows through the manifest adapter (id -> path -> normalized instance) with fallback verification when a file is deliberately hidden.
acceptanceCriteria: adapter loads 100 percent of manifest ids with category environment, prop, character or animation; zero missing
measured GLB extents match manifest targetSizeMeters within 6 percent on all axes
character AnimationTree exposes idle, skate, skate-air, die clips mapped from anim-* entries
hiding any one asset file degrades to its manifest fallback while the run continues (degraded-mode wrench flag true)
full park scene draws with draw calls under 220 in sim metrics
tests_staged/test_q03_asset_integration.sh exits 0

The three contract action beats fire with state/motion/visual/audio/HUD channels inside their timeline windows: ollie-beat 250 ms total, grind-beat 410 ms, bail-beat 900 ms; sparks pool recycles; balance meter readable; hitstop only on specials.
acceptanceCriteria: ollie-beat: vertical velocity sign flips within one physics tick of input; dust burst 8 particles; popup queued
grind-beat: latch snaps lateral offset under 0.15 m; spark burst 16; scrape loop audible flag true; meter visible by 200 ms
bail-beat: multiplier resets to 1; trauma 0.6 applied; banner slide-out completes by 900 ms
pool budgets respected: no runtime allocation beyond contract poolBudgets during 60 s trick soak
sim prints per-beat channel timing table matching windows within tolerance 30 ms

userStories.title: Camera, input matrix, mobile viewport and occlusion proven

Follow cam honors BRIEF constants (distance 5.2, FOV kick thresholds, trauma decay); keyboard, gamepad and touch-emulation inputs each drive the same public actions; portrait 390x844 keeps critical HUD inside safe areas with minimum target sizes; wall-hug occlusion rule engages on the warehouse corridor case.

gamepad probe: stick axis and face buttons produce identical state deltas as keyboard equivalents
